_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values so extracted.

project_millions.basis: UTA's USDA funded project, in millions of dollars

cases_floor.basis: more than this many confirmed animal cases as of November 12th, most in Texas

year_eliminated.basis: the year screwworm was declared eliminated from the US

projects.basis: projects selected nationwide, drawn one unit per project

program_millions.basis: roughly this many millions of USDA funding across the projects

traps_floor.basis: more than this many screwworm specific traps monitored since July 2025, drawn one unit per trap

flies_week_millions.basis: more than this many millions of sterile flies a week from Edinburg, drawn one fly per million

facility_millions.basis: the Edinburg dispersal facility's cost in millions

distinctions.basis: wild from sterile, and females from males

cells.basis: 2 x 2 combinations of the two distinctions

end_year.basis: the project runs through June of this year

pin_km.basis: great circle km between the gazetteer centroids of Kerr County (Kerrville, c19) and Hidalgo County (Edinburg, c21), rounded to whole km, used ONLY to set pin spacing on the relief and never printed

pins.basis: pin positions at the gazetteer centroids of the counties holding the two places the claims name

months_to_end.basis: calendar months from December 2026 through June 2028 inclusive, one fence post per month
